cover_sub: Explore the financial stability of nonprofits and how it impacts their operations.

slides.label: Operating Reserves
slides.headline: 40% of Nonprofits Struggle with Short Runways
slides.body: Approximately 40% of nonprofits have fewer than 3 months of operating reserves, indicating potential financial instability.

slides.label: Small Organizations
slides.headline: Small Orgs Invest Directly in Programs
slides.body: Nonprofits under $500K in revenue are more likely to have lean reserves, investing directly in programs rather than maintaining large reserves.

slides.label: Reserve Crisis
slides.headline: 48% Lack Adequate Reserves
slides.body: Nearly half of nonprofits do not have enough reserves to weather a funding gap, highlighting the importance of financial planning.

slides.label: Peer Context
slides.headline: Peer Financial Insight for Better Decisions
slides.body: Understanding the financial context of peers can help nonprofit leaders make informed decisions about their organizational stability and future.

slides.label: Data Source
slides.headline: Data from Public IRS 990 Filings
slides.body: All the data presented is sourced from public IRS 990 filings, ensuring transparency and accuracy in our analysis.

slides.label: Actionable Insights
slides.headline: Transform Data into Action
slides.body: Use this sector insight to better understand your financial health and take proactive steps towards securing your nonprofit's future.

cta_headline: Empower Your Nonprofit with Financial Clarity
cta_body:
